description:
Users do not find Spark under `benchbox tuning`: `PLATFORM_ALIASES["spark"] = "databricks"` (benchbox/core/tuning/capability_registry.py ~L152) makes Spark lookups resolve as Databricks (Liquid Clustering / Z-Order), `PLATFORM_TUNING_CAPABILITIES` has no spark row so `tuning platforms` (cli/commands/tuning_group.py ~L503) omits it, and `tuning init --platform spark` has no Spark branch.

Scope:
- Remove the spark to databricks alias; add a spark registry row using the existing `_session()` helper (capability_registry.py ~L100, currently unused) for the session-config mechanism. DO NOT add spark to `_INTERFACE_KNOWN_PLATFORMS`: that turns every unsupported-type warning into a hard error at config load (interface.py ~L1597-1604, cli/config.py ~L756) and would break existing custom Spark files that use table_tunings; it also conflicts with tests/unit/core/tuning/test_platform_identity_keys.py and the instruction in test_capability_source_drift.py ~L510-522. Follow the starrocks/doris precedent (registry row, not in the known set). The registry is keyed by TuningType and has no session type; decide the row shape, and check `tuning platforms` renders a session-only platform sensibly.
- `tuning init --platform spark` emits a documented, commented example of the `spark:` map (also check `is_compatible_with_platform`, cli/config.py ~L811-835). It must NOT ship as a curated `tuned` template, which would relabel `tuned-fallback` as `tuned` (ADR-002) without changing behaviour; curated templates are a separate item.
- `tuning show`, `validate` and `--dry-run` report the spark map; benchbox/cli/dryrun.py ~L665-676 renders nested dicts as str(dict), so render a Property/Value sub-table.
- Non-Spark platforms given a non-empty `spark` map (Databricks, EMR, Glue, Dataproc; cloud_spark/mixins.py ~L108-125 returns []) warn at validation and call ledger.record_dropped instead of silently ignoring.
- Docs: tuning guide section for Spark session config, including precedence and the preflight discrepancy report.
